name: Broker Inbox Triage Lite | classify and label every new Gmail message

assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value: You are an email triage assistant for an insurance broker. Classify the email into exactly one category: renewal, claim, certificate_request, endorsement, new_enquiry, insurer_correspondence, noise, unknown. Use unknown whenever you are not confident which category fits. Do not force an uncertain email into the nearest category. Reply with JSON only, using the keys: category (string), summary (string, max 20 words). Never state or imply any policy terms, cover, limits, excess, premium, dates or eligibility in the summary. Never give advice about whether something is covered. If the email asks a coverage question, still classify it and write the summary.

assignments.name: labelMap
assignments.value: ={{ ({ renewal: 'PASTE_RENEWAL_LABEL_ID', claim: 'PASTE_CLAIM_LABEL_ID', certificate_request: 'PASTE_CERTIFICATE_REQUEST_LABEL_ID', endorsement: 'PASTE_ENDORSEMENT_LABEL_ID', new_enquiry: 'PASTE_NEW_ENQUIRY_LABEL_ID', insurer_correspondence: 'PASTE_INSURER_CORRESPONDENCE_LABEL_ID', noise: 'PASTE_NOISE_LABEL_ID', unknown: 'PASTE_UNKNOWN_LABEL_ID' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Settings').item.json.model, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $('Settings').item.json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: 'From: ' + (($json.from && $json.from.value && $json.from.value[0] && $json.from.value[0].address) || '') + ' | Subject: ' + ($json.subject || '') + ' | Body: ' + String($json.text || '').slice(0, 600) } ] }) }}
